proposed.sourceName: Malaysian Journal of Syariah and Law — Gelatin in Halal Pharmaceutical Products (Tukiran, Ahmad Anuar & Jamaludin)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed study holding that gelatin is halal only when the source animal is established as permissible and properly slaughtered; where the source is unestablished, halal status cannot be affirmed and istihalah does not cure an impermissible or unverified origin.

proposed.sourceName: Heliyon — Towards halal pharmaceutical: Exploring alternatives to animal-based ingredients (Herdiana et al.)
proposed.paraphrase: Peer-reviewed review noting gelatin is predominantly sourced from pig and bovine tissue and that halal certification is essential to establish a permissible source; gelatin of unspecified origin cannot be treated as halal without verified halal provenance.

researcherNote: Hanafi-strict position (JAKIM/MUI/ESMA). Unverified animal origin cannot satisfy the strict slaughter requirement, supporting seeded draft grade 4 (Questionable - widely avoided). Two INDEPENDENT tier-2 sources. APPROVED by owner 2026-06-28.
